entities.name: Krark
entities.description: A legendary goblin wizard and gambler on Mirrodin who walked to the hollow center of the plane and wrote a book of his journey; executed for heresy.

entities.name: Oxidda mountains
entities.description: Mountains of Mirrodin where Krark lived.

entities.name: Durg
entities.description: Gambler who won Krark's thumbs and later handed back the lucky one.

entities.name: Cult of Krark
entities.description: A religion formed around Krark's writings, holding that Mirrodin is hollow.

entities.name: Book of Krark
entities.description: Krark's book describing his journey to the center of Mirrodin, preached from by the cult's leader.

entities.name: Steel Mother
entities.description: Figure whom Krark is believed to guide the souls of the dead to.

events.summary: Krark loses both his thumbs to Durg betting on a hellion race.
events.quote: He lost both his thumbs to Durg betting on a hellion race

events.summary: Krark bets Durg a thumb that he can walk to the center of Mirrodin and back.
events.quote: He bet Durg a thumb that he could walk to the center of Mirrodin and back.

events.summary: Weeks later Krark returns with a book of his journey and Durg hands over the lucky thumb.
events.quote: Durg sighed and handed over Krark's lucky thumb.

events.summary: Krark is executed for heresy and his followers excommunicated.
events.quote: Krark was executed for heresy and his followers excommunicated.

events.summary: After his death the Cult of Krark forms around his writings.
events.quote: a religion known as the Cult of Krark was formed around his writings

relations.quote: The Krark-Clan is named after him.

relations.note: gambling rival who won his thumbs
relations.quote: He lost both his thumbs to Durg betting on a hellion race
